decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the selection focusing on functional hiking and utility backpacks. The consideration set includes the specialized BASSDASH tackle bag, a large-capacity Mardingtop trekking pack, a compact NICGID sling, and a versatile G4Free tactical bag. I chose the SHENHU 40L hiking backpack because it offers the best combination of size, positive customer reviews regarding its durability and features, and an excellent value-for-money price point of $26.99, making it a highly practical choice for general outdoor use.
